title: Student report
evolution_subtitle: Shows the patient's progress across sessions. Helps identify improvement trends or the need to adjust the intervention.
support_level_subtitle: Shows the level of help needed for the patient to perform activities, ranging from full support to independence.
empty_support_level: No support level data for this student.
areas_worked_subtitle: Indicates which developmental domains were most stimulated, such as cognition, language, socioemotional skills and daily living activities.
activity_types_subtitle: Shows the distribution of intervention types performed, such as skill acquisition, generalization, assessment or behavior management.
empty_activity_types: No activity type data for this student.
approaches_subtitle: Shows which therapeutic approaches were most effective during sessions.
behaviors_subtitle: Shows the frequency of behaviors that may hinder learning, such as escape, stereotypies or opposition.
behavior_function_subtitle: Indicates the likely reason for these behaviors, such as seeking attention, escaping demands or sensory stimulation.
legend_hint: Tap the legend to highlight a category.
attention_subtitle: Shows the patient's focus pattern during sessions, such as sustained, oscillating or dispersed attention.
emotion_subtitle: Indicates the patient's emotional stability, identifying possible fluctuations or crises.
invalid_user_chart: Invalid user identifier for the session type chart.
insufficient_session_info: Insufficient unit or student name information to fetch ALT sessions.
empty_alt_sessions: No ALT sessions found for this student in this unit.
session_overdue: In-progress session with exceeded end time
showing_up_to: Showing up to {{count}} records. Use the ALT sessions page to see more.
list_loads_on_expand: The detailed list is only loaded when expanded.
empty_technical: Could not load the technical summary.
independence_subtitle: Degree of support needed to perform skills
behavior_intensity_subtitle: Average severity level of presented behaviors
skill_progress_subtitle: Acquisition and consolidation stage of the worked skills
aba_performance_clinical_inconsistent: Inconsistent responses or lack of functional learning
aba_performance_clinical_emerging: Emerging responses, reliance on support, and low generalization
aba_performance_clinical_specific: Consistent responses, though still dependent on specific conditions
aba_performance_clinical_high_accuracy: High accuracy, emerging independence, and stability
response_latency_subtitle: Average time to start the response after instruction
interfering_frequency_subtitle: Number of occurrences of behaviors that impact learning
engagement_level_subtitle: Quality of attention during the proposed activities
response_performance_subtitle: Percentage of correct independent responses per session
aba_pct_slight_drop: Slight drop in previously consolidated performance
aba_pct_drop_high_instability: Drop in performance with high instability
aba_pct_consistent_acquisition: Consistent progress during the acquisition process
aba_pct_decline_high_variability: Decline with high variability and instability
aba_pct_onset_gradual: Onset of acquisition with gradual progress
